style_guide.art_style: Soft watercolor children's book illustration with visible paper texture and gentle color bleeds, hand-painted brush strokes, tender storybook feel
style_guide.color_palette: Warm amber and orange sunset tones shifting into deep indigo, navy blue and violet night hues, accented by glowing golden-yellow firefly light and soft silver moonlight; cozy earthy browns for the hedgehog and forest
style_guide.mood: Cozy, gentle and dreamy, moving from timid nighttime fear to warm wonder and quiet courage; magical yet calm and reassuring for young children

character_descriptions.protagonist: Duri, a tiny round baby hedgehog with soft light-brown quills, a small pinkish nose, big round shy eyes and little brown paws, expressive and cuddly, always small in frame
character_descriptions.supporting: Byeori, a tiny baby firefly glowing soft warm yellow with one slightly drooping wing and a gentle round face; Grandpa Owl, a plump kindly owl with round spectacle-like eyes and soft feathers perched on a branch; a family of many fireflies twinkling like little golden stars

style_guide.environment_style: A soft-edged watercolor forest: mossy tree trunks, dewy grass, tall reeds by a calm stream, glowing round full moon and starry sky; light glows and reflections rendered with luminous washes and gentle blooms of color, generous negative space at the top for text overlay
style_guide.style_suffix: Soft watercolor children's book illustration, hand-painted texture with gentle color bleeds and visible paper grain, warm and dreamy storybook mood, tender child-friendly composition with soft rounded shapes and glowing light, generous calm negative space at the top for text. No text, no letters, no words, no watermark, no signature. Not photorealistic, no dark horror, no scary elements.
